should_fix.title: Do not offer a late permission for human selection while session cancel is pending
should_fix.smell: incomplete state rule, not a new abstraction
should_fix.body: An admitted session/cancel correctly commits RequestPermissionOutcome::Cancelled for permissions already pending, reserves that response capacity before acceptance, and refuses a second response after a canonical selection (lines 97-99). A permission that arrives while that cancel is still pending is also required to receive Cancelled under the retained cancel work. The same section still treats the first valid human admission as the canonical response (line 91), and line 99 only says no new human answer is inferred. A real allow or reject is not an inference. If that late request is published as selectable before Cancelled is committed, the human submission can win the canonical race, send Selected after session/cancel, and authorize the tool during cancellation. The protocol requires Cancelled for a pending session/request_permission once session/cancel has been sent. The same window applies to a session-scoped form: it must be ElicitationAction::Cancel, not Decline, and must not be left human-answerable. Reserve the response slot before retaining the inbound request; if egress capacity is gone, fail or degrade that work as unknown rather than offering a human choice.

consider.title: Fix the ProtocolVersion import citation before Plan copies it
consider.body: ProtocolVersion and ProtocolVersion::V1 live at the crate root, not in agent_client_protocol_schema::v1 (docs.rs 1.12.0 returns 404 for the v1 path). InitializeRequest, ContentBlock, and CancelNotification are in v1 and their constructors exist. This is a citation error, not a reason to reject the schema crate.

consider.title: Give authentication-required an authenticate transition in Plan
consider.body: The view can show authentication-required, and ClientRequest::AuthenticateRequest is a stable schema variant. The named local operations are open, inspect, prompt, answer, permission, interrupt, and close. Plan should add protocol-driven authenticate for an advertised agent-type method so that state is not terminal. Do not advertise auth.terminal or URL elicitation to fill the gap.

consider.title: Do not fake a native attachment to reuse conditional claims
consider.body: Conditional claims currently require a live attachment owner with native_connection. An ACP view is not a PTY. Reusing that gate by fabricating a native connection would violate the no-dummy-PTY rule. Plan should add an ACP eligibility path or state that conditional idle-yield is unavailable for agent views, while preserving the PTY path.

consider.title: Confirm cancellation only on stopReason cancelled
consider.body: Line 97 correctly refuses to confirm cancel from the notification, permission responses, closure, or timeout, and waits until the original prompt response. A literal reading of "supplies a stop reason" also matches end_turn, refusal, max_tokens, and max_turn_requests. Plan should confirm cancellation only for stopReason cancelled, record any other prompt result as its own protocol outcome, and release the single foreground slot on a JSON-RPC error so a non-conforming abort error cannot leave the session busy.

consider.title: Keep reading stderr after the retention cap
consider.body: Pinned stdio transport allows the agent to log on stderr. Line 101 bounds stderr and fails closed on overflow, but stopping the stderr read while the child still lives fills the OS pipe and can stall the agent. Plan should keep discarding after the cap or fail and reap; do not leave a live child with a stopped stderr reader.

consider.title: Answer unadvertised agent requests with a JSON-RPC error
consider.body: Schema 1.12.0 AgentRequest is the agent-to-client enum and includes fs, terminal, permission, elicitation, and extension requests. Permissions and forms are specified; unadvertised fs/terminal calls are only described as not advertised. A consumer that consumes those requests without an error response can stall the foreground prompt. Plan should return the JSON-RPC error and not treat silence as rejection.

consider.title: Do not invert ClientRequest and AgentRequest
consider.body: In schema 1.12.0, ClientRequest is what the client sends to the agent, and AgentRequest is what the agent sends to the client. Both expose method(). Plan should match inbound permission and elicitation traffic on AgentRequest, not on ClientRequest.
